clips.title: The story
paras: Mountaineer Stormpike is an Ironforge mountaineer stationed at Algaz Station in northern Loch Modan. Watching over the mountain pass leading toward the Wetlands, he works tirelessly to keep vital supply routes safe from lurking troggs and kobolds. As a proud member of the Stormpike clan, his loyalty lies squarely with Ironforge and the safety of dwarven lands.

Perched along the northern border of Loch Modan, Algaz Station serves as a critical checkpoint before the perilous descent into the Wetlands. Mountaineer Stormpike is stationed here amid rocky crags and constant wilderness threats. His primary duty is maintaining the line of communication and keeping the roads open for travelers and supply convoys traversing through Dun Algaz.

The northern reaches of Loch Modan are plagued by relentless pests, from kobolds infesting nearby digs to subterranean troggs. Stormpike routinely enlists passing adventurers to disrupt these threats, particularly targeting the kobolds who have moved into the Silver Stream Mine and put their filthy paws on the Miners' League's stored dwarven tools.
